<vbox id="SyncPanel" align="start">
            <vbox>
              <checkbox
                id="offline.selectForOfflineFolder"
                data-l10n-id="folder-props-select-for-offline"
                hidefor="nntp"
                wsm_persist="true"
              />
              <checkbox
                id="offline.selectForOfflineNewsgroup"
                data-l10n-id="folder-props-select-newsgroup-for-offline"
                hidefor="imap,ews"
                wsm_persist="true"
              />
            </vbox>
            <button
              id="offline.offlineFolderDownloadButton"
              data-l10n-id="folder-props-download-now"
              orient="right"
              hidefor="nntp"
              oncommand="onOfflineFolderDownload()"
            />
            <button
              id="offline.offlineNewsgroupDownloadButton"
              data-l10n-id="folder-props-download-newsgroup-now"
              orient="right"
              hidefor="imap,ews"
              oncommand="onOfflineFolderDownload()"
            />
